title: Heterogeneity in winged helix-turn-helix and substrate DNA interactions: Insights from theory and experiments.
one_liner_zh: 该文结合理论分析与分子对接，系统刻画翼状螺旋-转角-螺旋（wHTH）转录因子与底物DNA互作的异质性，并实验验证预测，虽非AI/深度学习或MD方法，但聚焦TF-DNA结合机制建模，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract: Specific interactions between transcription factors (TFs) and substrate DNA constitute the fundamental basis of gene expression. Unlike in TFs like basic helix-loop-helix or basic leucine zippers, prediction of substrate DNA is extremely challenging for helix-turn-helix (HTH). Experimental techniques like chromatin immunoprecipitation combined with massively parallel DNA sequencing remains a viable option. We characterize the molecular basis of heterogeneity in HTH-DNA interaction using in silico tools and thence validate them experimentally. Given the profound functional diversity in HTH, we focus primarily on winged-HTH (wHTH). We consider 180 wHTH TFs, whose experimental three-dimensional structures are available in DNA bound/unbound conformations. Starting with PDB-wide scanning and curation of data, we construct a phylogenetic tree, which distributes 180 wHTH sequences under multiple sub-groups. Structure-sequence alignment followed by detailed intra/intergroup analysis, covariation studies and extensive network theory analysis help us to gain deep insight into heterogeneous wHTH-substrate DNA interactions. A central aim of this study is to find a consensus to predict the substrate DNA sequence for wHTH, amidst heterogeneity. The strength of our exhaustive theoretical investigations including molecular docking are successfully tested through experimental characterization of wHTH TF from Sulfurimonas denitrificans.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）与底物DNA之间的特异性相互作用构成了基因表达的基础。与碱性螺旋-环-螺旋或碱性亮氨酸拉链等转录因子不同，螺旋-转角-螺旋（HTH）的底物DNA预测极具挑战性。染色质免疫沉淀结合大规模并行DNA测序等实验技术仍是可行的选择。我们利用计算机模拟工具表征了HTH-DNA相互作用的异质性分子基础，并随后通过实验加以验证。鉴于HTH功能多样性显著，我们主要聚焦于翼状HTH（wHTH）。我们考虑了180个wHTH转录因子，其实验三维结构在DNA结合/未结合构象中均可获得。从PDB全库扫描和数据整理开始，我们构建了一棵系统发育树，将180个wHTH序列分布到多个亚组中。结构-序列比对，随后进行详细的组内/组间分析、共变研究及广泛的网络理论分析，帮助我们深入洞察异质性wHTH-底物DNA相互作用。本研究的一个核心目标是在异质性中寻找预测wHTH底物DNA序列的共识。我们详尽的理论研究（包括分子对接）的强度，通过来自脱氮硫单胞菌（Sulfurimonas denitrificans）的wHTH转录因子的实验表征得到了成功验证。
